📺 Station 19 (2018–2024)

Station 19 follows a courageous team of firefighters working at Seattle Fire Station 19 as they risk their lives to protect their community while navigating complicated relationships and personal struggles. Led by passionate firefighters like Andy Herrera, Maya Bishop, and Jack Gibson, the crew faces dangerous fires, devastating accidents, and life-threatening rescue missions that test their bravery and teamwork. Beyond the emergencies, they experience emotional challenges involving love, friendship, family, career ambitions, and unexpected tragedies. As they work together through difficult situations, the firefighters develop powerful bonds and become a second family, always supporting one another when it matters most. Filled with thrilling action, heartfelt moments, and unforgettable characters, Station 19 explores courage, sacrifice, loyalty, and the extraordinary dedication of first responders.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Romance • Emergency Services

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Stacy McKee

📺 Seasons: 7

📚 Spin-off Of: Grey’s Anatomy

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Station 19 is an American action and procedural drama television series created by Stacy McKee that premiered on the American Broadcasting Company (ABC) on March 22, 2018. It is the second spin-off of Grey's Anatomy (after Private Practice). Set in Seattle, the series focuses on the lives of the men and women at Seattle Fire Station 19. The main cast includes Jaina Lee Ortiz, Jason George, Grey Damon, Barrett Doss, Alberto Frezza, Jay Hayden, Okieriete Onaodowan, Danielle Savre, Miguel Sandoval, Boris Kodjoe, Stefania Spampinato, Carlos Miranda, Josh Randall, Merle Dandridge, and Pat Healy.
